reading.rtitle: A note from the front desk
paras: Mr. de Souza, here are the three places you asked about.

THE RESTAURANT. The Blue Door is on Market Street, two streets from the hotel. Turn left at the entrance, walk straight for five minutes, and it is on the corner, opposite the bank. It is a blue door, so it is easy to find.
THE PHARMACY. There is one very near, in the same street as the hotel, next to the coffee shop. It is open until midnight, every day.

THE STATION. The station is not near. It is twenty minutes on foot, or six minutes by taxi. Do not walk with your luggage. Turn right at the entrance and the taxis are in front of the hotel, all day and all night.
One more thing. Market Street and Market Square are two different places, and they are far from each other. People make this mistake every week. The restaurant is on the STREET.

listenings.text: Hey, it's me. You are near the hotel, right? Okay, listen, it is very easy. Come out of the hotel and turn left. Walk straight, two streets. Do not turn before that, because the first street goes down to the river and you do not want that. After two streets you see a bank on your right. The restaurant is on the corner, opposite the bank. Blue door, you cannot miss it. If you get to the big church, you walked too much, so come back one street. It is a ten minute walk, no more. And do not take a taxi for this, it is really close. See you in twenty minutes.

Thank you for calling the city information line. Here is what is open today, Sunday. The museum is open from ten to six. It is in the old town, next to the big square, and the entrance is on the small street behind the building, not in front. The market is closed today, and it opens again tomorrow at seven in the morning. The pharmacy on Market Street is open all day and all night. And please note: there is work on the main street this week, so the buses do not stop in front of the station. They stop two streets away, near the park. Thank you, and have a good Sunday.

extra_audio.text: Excuse me, where is the station? Is it near here? Sorry, left or right? So, straight for two streets and then left. Thank you very much.
